evidence.observation: Pressure held steady at about 2.97-3.01 Torr through the ramp and early growth at 100 sccm Ar.
Pressure rose steadily from 2.973 to 3.087, 3.13 and then 3.228 Torr over 360 s.
Argon flow steady at about 100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not caused by the mass flow controller (MFC).
Temperature has settled at 750 °C and heater power is normal.
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed, so the atmosphere cannot be checked to separate an air leak from an exhaust blockage.

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading, or a leak-up or isolation test (close the Ar supply and see whether pressure keeps rising), or a check of the exhaust line or pump. Either would tell a seal leak apart from an exhaust blockage. No sample characterization exists yet.
